name: Qatar Visit Visa (Hayya e-visa platform)

requirements.blocker_text: Travel must be for tourism, a business visit, or transit, applied for via the Hayya e-visa platform.

evidence_required.document: Hayya e-visa application / QAR 100 fee (paid categories)

outcome.duration_length: typically 30 days, extendable; some nationality-specific bilateral arrangements grant longer stays (e.g. US citizens: 2-year multi-entry, 90 days per stay)

sources.title: Visit Qatar (official Qatar Tourism authority) -- visa categories: ~102 nationalities visa-free/visa-on-arrival, GCC nationals fully exempt, Hayya e-visa platform (A1 tourist / A2 GCC-resident / A3 specific-nationality categories), QAR 100 fee for paid categories, joint Qatar-Oman tourist visa (30 days extendable), Qatar Airways transit visa options

notes: NEW COUNTRY BUILD (Qatar). STATUS: PUBLISHED -- tier-1 sourced via Qatar's official tourism authority. MOI's own visa portal (portal.moi.gov.qa/qatarvisas/), the primary tier-1 counterpart, was unreachable in this build (robots.txt / SSL errors) -- recommend a direct re-fetch attempt to corroborate/replace this source if a stronger primary citation is needed later.
